verdict.rationale: Adyen's documentation-tools page describes an llms.txt at docs.adyen.com/llms.txt that follows the proposed standard. It also says most docs pages render as raw markdown by appending `.md`, offers a full documentation mirror ZIP for giving context to AI agents, and points to OpenAPI specs in a GitHub repo as LLM context. Live probes returned HTTP 200 for both llms.txt and a `.md` docs page, giving hands-on corroboration of the agent-oriented docs surface.
